name: agent-shuriken
description: Careful plugins for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: account-cleanup
plugins.description: Find web accounts you no longer use without reading any passwords, then cancel subscriptions and delete the accounts you approve

plugins.name: compare-report
plugins.description: Research the candidates for a choice and write an HTML and PDF comparison report, with a source for every claim and a rationale for every score

plugins.name: convey
plugins.description: Write messages that tell people what they need, with the conclusion first and nothing the reader does not need, for Slack, Discord, email, or GitHub, checked for length, formatting, and private details before they are copied

plugins.name: design-formats
plugins.description: How documents and reports explain and look, for skills that write them: two formats, four pattern files with sourced rules, four HTML page templates, and a script that checks a page or a document

plugins.name: diagram-composer
plugins.description: Design the diagram area of a slide with one visual metaphor, a meaning for every connector, and labels kept off the lines, checked by a script before the slide is rendered

plugins.name: diagram-explainer
plugins.description: Write an explainer as one HTML file with a figure drawn in every section, built from JSON and checked before you share it

plugins.name: diagram-styles
plugins.description: Figures for articles and technical books, designed from the reader's questions first and drawn in one of thirty-two built-in styles or a style from your own catalog and samples in ~/.styles

plugins.name: doc-formats
plugins.description: Shared document formats that other skills follow, starting with the format of a design document and a script that checks every section is filled in

plugins.name: docs-publish
plugins.description: Write the documentation of a library, command-line tool, or web service you build, public or private, in five parts, Quickstart, Concepts, API reference, Cookbook, and FAQ, in English and a second language you pick, with every page's translation and every relative link checked

plugins.name: evm-dev
plugins.description: Tells whether an ERC is final or an EIP is live on Ethereum mainnet, writes Solidity contracts and their tests for the solc, OpenZeppelin, Foundry, and Hardhat versions a project uses, deploys them without the agent touching keys and records what was deployed, checks a release against the deployed version and the target chains, and designs contracts, wallets, multichain apps, dApp architectures, and apps built on financial standards such as ISO 20022 and FIX, from dated items checked against the official documents

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagram
plugins.description: Draw architecture, flow, sequence, and ER diagrams as Excalidraw files laid out by a script, checked for overlaps, crowded spacing, and labels on lines, with SVG and PNG copies and no downloads

plugins.name: feedback-loop
plugins.description: When you correct an agent's work, record the correction, fix the files, have an evaluator that edits nothing judge the fix, and repeat until it passes, keeping the lesson as a check or a rule for next time

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Set up a project for local work: pick a free local port, add a Docker setup, and link its env files to 1Password with references, writing each file only after you approve it

plugins.name: japanese-speaking
plugins.description: Write Japanese that sounds like people talking, not reading lines, for podcast and radio dialogue, a news item one host reads and both discuss, interviews, narration, and talk scripts, checked by a script and a fresh reader before you use it

plugins.name: japanese-writing
plugins.description: Write and fix Japanese text so that it reads naturally and adds nothing the original does not say, with the steps and scripts of coji/natural-japanese and rules for repository Markdown, metaphor verbs, explanations, and questions

plugins.name: learning-to-skill
plugins.description: Write the lessons from a session into the instruction files your agents read, such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Copilot's instructions, or a skill's SKILL.md, in the right place and without duplicates, only after you approve the diff

plugins.name: machine-cleanup
plugins.description: Free disk space, memory, and CPU on your computer: find caches tools rebuild, build output git ignores, large and duplicate files, idle projects, unused apps and their leftovers, old tool versions, AI models, and dev servers left running, pick on a local page, and free only your picks, with anything another session uses kept out of reach

plugins.name: portman
plugins.description: Keep a registry of the localhost ports each project uses, so dev servers never collide: see what holds each port right now, get free ports that avoid common defaults, find collisions, and write a project's ports to .env.local and a Docker Compose override after you approve

plugins.name: repo-progress
plugins.description: See where every repository you work on stands in one table: worktrees, open issues and pull requests, uncommitted files, and which ones have stalled, without changing anything

plugins.name: secure-dotfile
plugins.description: Find API keys and tokens written into your shell startup files, ~/.npmrc, and ~/.aws/credentials and move the ones you pick into the macOS Keychain, the Linux secret service, pass, or 1Password, without the agent seeing any value

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Hand an agent session over to a new one: a short message to paste, and a saved state of the options already rejected, the current phase, delegated work, and things not to do, with anything that looks like a secret refused

plugins.name: skill-tune
plugins.description: Measure a plugin's skill with claude plugin eval cases kept in the plugin, shorten its SKILL.md, and measure again so that no case scores lower, with the cost agreed before any run and the size capped in the plugin's test

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Write and check the outline of a deck of ten or more slides, and design a short presentation as HTML that you edit in the browser and export as PowerPoint, PDF, and HTML

plugins.name: techdebt
plugins.description: Rank the files most worth fixing by combining how often they change with their size, old TODO comments, missing tests, long functions, and duplication, without downloading anything
